final:
-- A plain name is one file name: non-empty, no path separators, no "..".
is_plain_name(name: str) -> bool =
  post out == False or name.char_count() > 0
  ex is_plain_name("a.txt") == True
  ex is_plain_name("../x") == False
  if name.char_count() == 0
    return False
  if name.split("/").len() > 1 or name.split("\\").len() > 1
    return False
  if name.split("..").len() > 1
    return False
  True

-- Text of notes/name. Returns "" when the name is not plain or the file is missing or unreadable.
read_note(name: str) -> str uses fs =
  post is_plain_name(name) or out == ""
  ex read_note("no-such-file.txt") == ""
  if not is_plain_name(name)
    return ""
  with fs = fs.sub("notes")
    let text = fs.read(name) else ""
    return text
